title: Class Schedule
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: CLASS SCHEDULE
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines; consistent pointer base 17125; exact end marker and payload length; exact independently processed left/right byte agreement after timing refinement
